question: Do linked small source exports qualify actual Tsukui author-retained barcodes and named states, and can local resources support the authorized RDS fallback?
decision: Return author-code labels and exact retention/occupancy/resource hold for design review; no external expression.
strongest_rival: Mistaking author code annotation order for saved-object labels, unfiltered barcodes for retained cells, or missing metadata for verified zero-state support.
discriminator: Locate author annotations and export instructions at a fixed code revision; compare complete repository tree and GEO listing, reuse verified sample/day metadata, and distinguish resource observations from unknown RDS memory requirements.
exposure_record: X0 barcode/sample results, article/indexed code availability and all author code were read before freeze. Resource checks completed. Author annotation vector is exposed. No RDS acquired or deserialized and no expression accessed.
biological_unit: Reported mouse samples for X3; public studies and their reported sample counts for X5. Exact animal/donor identities are unresolved.
nesting_and_overlap: Cells nest in reported samples; samples can share donors and studies. Reused Salcher and Ravel source studies are not independent replication.
population_and_selection: Complete linked author code tree; all eleven annotation-vector positions; all twelve reported samples crossed with the three proposed author labels. This is an unknown-support request grid, not a retained-cell dataset.
contrast: Code/source availability and resource qualification; unchanged conditional day-versus-day0 design is recorded only.
endpoint: Code label provenance, available source/export paths, resource observations, unknown retained/state/ambiguity fields and exact reopening condition.
methods: Parse exact author vector and code locators; preserve runtime levels(MG) binding. Cross frozen X0 sample/day coverage with nominated labels using blank unavailable fields. Record existing resource and access receipts. No R code execution, RDS parsing, expression matrix or new state assignment.
missingness_and_exclusions: Absent retained-state metadata remains blank/unknown, never zero. The intended annotation vector does not identify actual deposited-object fields. Failure to qualify runtime or memory holds RDS acquisition. No samples or state support thresholds altered.
multiplicity: Not applicable: source metadata and availability only, no biological effect tests.
precision_basis: No population effect estimated. Eligibility and metadata counts are not power calculations.
interpretation_limit: Only intended author-code names are recovered. Actual retained/dropped cells, object labels, all-state sample occupancy and ambiguity remain unknown. Available X storage alone does not qualify a metadata-only reader or unknown object memory peak.
stop_rule: Stop at code provenance and resource hold. Reopen with actual small retained-cell/state export or a qualified metadata-only runtime/memory route for the specifically listed object; expression requires separate reviewed design.
amendment_reason: New authorized checkpoint-B source follow-up, preserving X0 and every frozen result.
